relations: Purple star slumps into a smear spreading outward into the surrounding white liquid pool.
Silvery star softens as its surface film develops expanding concentric swirls creeping toward the upper-right rim.
Green-streaked pool mixes with the melting material while a faint orange glow appears at the lower rim.
Spoon, pale-blue handle, black stand, and background remain fixed throughout the melting process.
caption: The video captures a top-down close view of a small brass melting spoon with a pale-blue glass handle. It rests on a black circular stand flanked by two dark wooden side handles. Inside the spoon's bowl, a deep purple star-shaped solid sits at left and a silvery-lavender star at right, both partly embedded in a milky pool streaked with pale green. Throughout the clip the purple star progressively loses its crisp five-point outline as its tips round off and its body slumps into an irregular blob, leaving a purple smear toward the left wall. The smear spreads outward into the surrounding white liquid as the solid flattens. The silvery star also softens, while the silvery film above it develops expanding concentric swirl and foam-like textures that creep toward the upper-right rim. The green-streaked pool mixes with the melted material. A faint orange glow appears at the spoon's lower rim, while the spoon, handle, stand and background remain fixed in place.
